beats.text: On September twenty-seventh, Trump called Portland 'war-ravaged' and ordered up to two hundred National Guard troops in.

beats.caption: to protect war ravaged Portland and any of our ICE Facilities
beats.label: via CNN

beats.text: Portland: known for coffee shops and rain, apparently now also a war zone, per the president.

beats.caption: I am also authorizing full force if necessary.
beats.label: via CNN

beats.text: That order landed while Oregon's governor stood outside, looking distinctly unbesieged.

beats.caption: This city is safe and calm and it is a beautiful day to be here.
beats.label: via KATU News

beats.text: She wasn't finished making that point.

beats.caption: But they are not needed in this city. They are not needed here.
beats.label: via KATU News

beats.text: Zero troops needed, said the people who actually live there. Oregon and Portland sued, and a judge blocked the deployment.
